parsed.post: Discarding the 0.977976 result as it regressed from my best 0.973052. It seems the recent change to DEPTH 8 with MATRIX_LR 0.03 was less effective than the previous configuration or suffered from instability. Reverting to my best and will try to probe MATRIX_LR 0.04 to find a better local optimum.
parsed.description: Probing a slightly higher learning rate (0.04) at DEPTH 8 to see if it provides better convergence than 0.03 without the instability of higher values.
